meta.name: process:documents
meta.description: 231 (plan stage C, C3b3; DECISIONS 231): the processing of a folder's or some chosen files' documents as a process pack (until C3 a plain kind of work package and a workflow step kind): a case makes its processing package from its source, a person starts its live run within the package's estimate, and the case is done once a live run is approved; the package's processing, review and result open from the case's page.

changelog.note: 231 (U2b; the owner's decisions of 2026-10-28: one work list, the cases): a document batch made before every batch was a case's (a folder's, chosen files', a watched folder's, an upload's), not hidden and of no rule another process takes, is wrapped by a case of the pack (wraps by its kind); a watched folder's new batch gets its case at once.
231 (U1e; the owner's decision of 2026-10-28): its example material: invented invoices, foreign invoices and receipts, and quote requests on a printed form (configs/examples_documents.json).
231 (U0): what the process is for, shown when a person picks a process to start a case of

231 (C3b5b; the owner's decision of 2026-10-26): the workflows' documents step is the pack's (workflow): its new package gets a case of the pack, and its live run starts within the step's budget as before.
231 (C3b3): the first version: the document processing step (process_documents@1, the documents' maker) and its tabs: Documents, History.

title: Documents
summary: Documents from a folder or chosen files: their type is recognised and their data extracted, for a person to check and approve.
